source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In the Fight phase, once this unit has fought, pick one enemy unit that has the MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword and was hit by at least one of those attacks. That enemy unit counts as suppressed until the next turn ends; attacks made by models in a suppressed unit get -1 to their Hit rolls.
